Quebec Duo Angine de Poitrine Wins 2026 Polaris Music Prize

Quebec rock duo Angine de Poitrine has won the 2026 Polaris Music Prize. The duo, identified as "space-time voyagers" Klek and Khn, received the award along with a $30,000 prize for their second album, "Vol. II."
